title: Extremal List Gaps and Inapproximability in Additive Graph Labeling
summary: We study a vertex-labeling analogue of the $1$-$2$-$3$ problem and its list version. For a labeling $\ell:V(G)\to\mathbb N$, let $S_\ell(v)=\sum_{w\in N(v)}\ell(w)$. The additive number $η(G)$ is the least $k$ for which there exists $\ell:V(G)\to[k]$ such that $S_\ell(u)\ne S_\ell(v)$ for every $uv\in E(G)$, while the list additive number $η_\ell(G)$ is the least $k$ such that the same condition can be satisfied from every assignment of $k$-element lists $L(v)\subset\mathbb N$ with $\ell(v)\in L(v)$.
